title: CEOs who think AI replaces their employees are just bad CEOs
summary: This TechDirt editorial argues that CEOs who believe AI will simply replace their employees are fundamentally misunderstanding both technology and business management. The article suggests that such thinking reveals poor leadership rather than forward-thinking strategy.
problem_solved: Challenges the misconception that AI adoption in business automatically means workforce replacement
why_valuable: Provides a counter-narrative to the fear-driven discourse around AI and job displacement, emphasizing human-AI collaboration over replacement
